test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All machines are refrigerators.

All refrigerators are geysers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some machines are not geysers.

II. Some geysers are machines.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statements:

All machines are refrigerators.

All refrigerators are geysers.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8b6a9ac1c409f0f8be3635d8929299711503d8490053dfd9530118819ecbb6d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some machines are not geysers → False (It is not possible because all machines are refrigerators and all refrigerators are geysers so some machines are definitely geyser)

II. Some geysers are machines → True (because all machines are refrigerators and all refrigerators are geysers so some geysers are definitely machines)

__
 
• Some + Some not - It is not a complementary pair.

Hence, “**Only conclusion II follows**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Conditions of Either-or case:

1. Individually both the conclusions should be false.

2. One conclusion should be positive and one conclusion should be negative (Complementary pair)

The two complementary pairs are:

1) All + Some not

2) No + Some

 
• Some + Some not - It is not a complementary pair.
